model_annotations.Bulgarian: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output, comparing values before and after gating processes. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from -1 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”, begins at approximately 0.83 at x = -1 and decreases to approximately 0.02 at x = 21. An orange dotted line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”, starts at approximately 0.81 at x = -1, decreases to approximately 0.25 at x = 5, and then fluctuates between approximately 0.2 and 0.35 until reaching approximately 0.23 at x = 21. A green dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”, begins at approximately 0.76 at x = -1, decreases to approximately 0.15 at x = 5, and then fluctuates between approximately 0.1 and 0.2 until reaching approximately 0.12 at x = 21.
